body:
I woke up today, and decided today I would trip. The time is 2 PM. I grabbed my coke straw and my bag of MXE and took a bump of about 30mg. I lay down and my dog came over, I played Disgaea 3. It was very interesting.  I got up to take my dog out. Suddenly I feel that I am 47 feet tall, walking my dog was interesting. I feel like the world is only 200 feet around. I return to the house, drink 3 cups of Mescaline [cactus extract?] and grapefruit juice. I go upstairs and take another 30mg bump of the MXE.  I lie down and try to play my game more. I reach a point where my character interacts with his own heart and decide to take a break.
I turn on the television. It's a program about the Jersey Devil. Some useless fluff for me to ponder as I collect my 7th sense. I get a call from my aunt. We talk for what feels like hours about psychedelics, Hunter S Thompson, hashish and poodles. She describes her new house which gives me a perfect picture of it. I explore her house quickly and return to my own home. Eventually she has to go because she has company, and we hang up.  I finish my bag of mxe and begin to watch Star Wars.
Star Wars is my favorite movie. I feel like I've become Luke Skywalker. For some reason I remember the Robot Chicken specials interspersed with the movies. This trip is very intense! I feel true fear whenever I see an imperial trooper. Han Solo seems to be guiding my trip. My mind has left my body and entered Star Wars. I learned so much about Star Wars that I know everything before it happens, I'm about to feel the weirdest de ja vu ever. I've never done PCP but I think I understand what it is now. I went on a journey to buy cigarettes and now I came back to the real world. I felt like I was walking for forever and that nothing was real, For a short time I feel trapped, walking towards my house, just like the trash compactor. I walk on. I walk so far without any problems and now Star Wars is my reward. I felt everything the way Luke would have experienced it.  Everything seems fine, I make my way back to the Millennium Falcon shortly after Obi-Wan was killed. My life and Star Wars parallel each other again. I am my own Luke Skywalker. And for what it is, it feels great. I think everything is the way it needs to be. As I feel myself starting to come down, the Death Star is destroyed and there is peace in the galaxy and my mind. Star Wars guided me through a fantastic trip. Kid Robot, signing off.
[Reported Dose: 200mg]
